title: Q4 Planning for Contractors — What to Lock In Before Year End
content:
### **Why Q4 Matters More Than It Seems** 

The companies that dominate a territory by next summer are usually the ones who made the decision in Q4 — not the ones scrambling in March once the season is already underway. 

###  **What to Evaluate Now** 

Whether your trade category and preferred ZIP codes remain available. Territory availability changes as other companies secure their categories, and Q4 conversations often have more options than Q1 or Q2 conversations do. 

###  **The Planning Window** 

A Q4 territory review gives a company the full winter to plan, decide, and — if a pilot begins — build recognition before the busy season arrives. 

### **Starting the Conversation** 

A brief review now costs nothing and confirms exactly where things stand for your trade and area heading into next year.
